edges: Dr Watson is called to tend to Sherlock Holmes, who is apparently dying.
Holmes instructs Watson not to come near him due to the infectious nature of his illness.
Holmes instructs Watson to bring Mr Culverton Smith to see him.
Watson forces his way into Mr Culverton Smith's residence.
Holmes calls for Watson to present himself as a witness to the conversation.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mr Culverton Smith pockets the little ivory box, removing the evidence of his crime.
Mrs. Hudson informs Dr Watson about Holmes's condition.
